elements.title: Origin, named or suggested
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map-ai-opportunity/<name>.json › ai[].origin: named (a grounded quote) or suggested (an inferred reading)

elements.title: What it would do
elements.fulfilled_by: process-map-ai-opportunity/<name>.json › ai[].does: one to three sentences

elements.title: Flow view

elements.title: On-the-map view
elements.fulfilled_by: computed by build_map.py: the third tab, data-view=map, and the base board (svg.pm-board) in #board

elements.fulfilled_by: computed by build_map.py from every cite in the file and its base: one numbered marker (a.cp-mk) on each cited element, and section#citation-points with one li.cp-row per point the page uses
